content:
i wasn't motivated to pull gogier in the first place but i also think his direction is really weird.
The things that really need to be enhanced are his defensive capabilities. I do not understand the point of trying to fit so much strength scaling into his kit when he is a warden and should do the job of defending the team, and the "he's defending by killing the enemy" isn't a good excuse and shouldn't be how a warden is made.
Why do Undertow stacks not buff his str down/shield numbers? It buffing only the damage numbers makes 0 sense and we hit the problem of why make him a warden in the first place. It buffing exalt shield is fine and makes sense but the lack of defense/str down increase makes it very dubious why he's considered a "warden" in the first place. his E2 should also be a double defense play and e3 should, again, result in Undertow buffing his shield/str-down numbers.
